vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; tools should empower individuals, not just big labs with secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；工具应赋能个体，而非仅服务于拥有秘密模型和数据中心的大实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已显现明确的产品市场契合：15 万账户和每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲采用。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化在全球范围扩展所有权，让任何拥有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail investors should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户应能尽早投资私营公司，而非仅限机构。

richardsocher.en: Regulate AI applications and users, not intelligence or GPU compute; regulating abstract intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 监管应针对具体应用与使用者，而非智能本身或 GPU 算力；监管抽象智能等于监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence's biggest promise is science—physics, chemistry, biology, medicine—not job automation.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最大的价值在科学——物理、化学、生物、医学，而非取代工作的自动化。

richardsocher.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable as AI automates AI research, but slow takeoff is constrained by hardware, physical and economic limits.
richardsocher.zh: 随着 AI 自动化 AI 研究，递归自我改进不可避免，但起飞受硬件、物理与经济约束而偏慢。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language remains the deepest manifestation of intelligence and language models have far more room to grow.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言仍是最深层的智能体现，语言模型还有更大成长空间。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI beats concentrating power; hard constraints like Constitutional AI are mostly marketing.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全：更多善意行为者掌握多样 AI 优于权力集中；宪法式 AI 等硬约束多是营销。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的突破；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on agents.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；制约智能体的是记忆，而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own models rise: Cognition and Cursor train specialized models for cost and latency, while open models gain share and fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: 自研模型崛起：Cognition 和 Cursor 为成本与延迟训练专用模型，同时开源模型份额上升、微调服务走向成熟。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed; coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs and software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中层 SaaS 注定消亡；编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，开启中小企业与“一人受众”软件的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders breaking into AI.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科——围绕模型搭建 harness——对闯入 AI 的圈外人而言，公开学习胜过学历主义。

erikbernhardsson.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; owning the file system, runtime and scheduler is real alpha.
erikbernhardsson.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 负载从零重建，而不是在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包一层；自研文件系统、容器运行时和调度器才是真正的优势来源。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds beats three-year rectangular deals.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可获取，代价是更高价格和更长合约；聚合 25 家以上云的需求，胜过被三年期“长方形”合约锁死。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud, a $100B market; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom, so a broad post-training and agentic platform creates switching costs.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云，是千亿美元级市场；只卖 token 是价格战，覆盖后训练与智能体工具的完整平台才能形成切换成本。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on long-horizon tasks; open-source models are often good enough without fine-tuning.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练在编程等反馈闭环有限的任务上有效，但在长周期任务上可能遇到瓶颈；开源模型往往无需微调就已够用。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversing earlier view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months; compute is not fungible and public pricing data is untrustworthy.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 立场转变：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨；算力并非可互换资产，公开定价数据不可信。

diogoalmeida.en: From mid-2026, he argues the bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute, and scaling laws work only because both are available.
diogoalmeida.zh: 从 2026 年中期起，他主张“苦涩教训”是错的：数据与选对任务比算力更重要，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律之所以奏效，只是因为数据可得、任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Across 2026 he insists most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; you cannot optimize both without shattering the space.
diogoalmeida.zh: 整个 2026 年他反复强调：多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；同时优化辅助与自动化会撕裂整个空间，二者不可兼得。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he sharpens this into a critique of RLHF: it destroyed calibration and causes mode-dropping, while pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年末，他把这一思路深化为对基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的批评：RLHF 破坏了校准并导致模式坍缩，而预训练模型在决策上校准更好。

diogoalmeida.en: His proposed fix evolves from RLCD and exposing probabilities as knobs to a machine-native decision model, with post-training, not pre-training, as the path to 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他的解法从 RLCD、把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，演进为机器原生的决策模型；并认为 10 倍跃升要靠后训练而非预训练。

diogoalmeida.en: Consistently he treats reliability, not speed, cost or benchmarks, as the real bottleneck, and keeps humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 始终不变的是：他把可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数视为真正瓶颈，并坚持高风险决策要保留人类在环。

altman.en: Early framing: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked. Deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进；主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并判断算力将成为最稀缺的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但体感进展是渐进的；智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战；安全要靠迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and poorly defined; the goal is a continuous ramp to superintelligence, with humans in control and power broadly distributed.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变的、定义模糊；目标转向通往超级智能的连续爬坡，同时必须让人保持控制、让权力广泛分布。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails. Compute is a profit center, and iterative deployment plus human judgment remain the throughline.
altman.zh: 对齐尚未解决，若安全论证不成立就暂停前沿训练；算力是利润中心而非成本；迭代部署与人类判断力始终是贯穿主线。

tworek.en: Reasoning means longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理意味着更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI; continual learning is necessary.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环；持续学习必不可少。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；架构而非仅缩放定律，才是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; better algorithms for learning from experience will emerge.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但单靠强化学习效率低下；更好的从经验中学习的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams using capable agents; fine-tuning is unreliable and models should learn on the fly toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强大智能体的小团队；微调不可靠，模型应即时学习，走向后劳动社会。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业能力更重要，而初级人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era: assign long-running tasks, but delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 已从聊天机器人来回对话进入智能体时代：可派发长时任务，但委托会侵蚀判断产出所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; give it harder tasks, since most people underestimate current models.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非答案机；给它更难的任务，因为多数人低估了当前模型。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须自底重建工作流以增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is the real constraint.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；真正的约束是供给受限的 AI 基础设施。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是外包学习；跳过练习是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Only about 2% agent adoption; AI safety and security are the defining challenges for enterprise adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体采用率仅约 2%；AI 安全与防护是企业采用的决定性挑战。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon; no infrastructure overbuild.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把思科定位为卖铲子的 AI 基础设施公司：网络、安全、芯片；并认为基础设施不存在过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, use AI as tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要警惕但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当顺风。

sundarpichai.en: AI investments redefine every Alphabet business; full-stack approach drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务；全栈路线推动营收增长 24%、云业务积压订单创纪录。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI development over short-term cloud revenue.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先保障前沿 AI 研究与 AGI（通用人工智能）开发，而非云业务的短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱隔离与独立评估方。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent rather than cannibalizing.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图而非蚕食存量。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from executors to editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality, since AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类判断把关品质——AI 抬高上限，却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI-built prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents; break complex tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; the limiting factor becomes ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；瓶颈由此变成想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more as AI-generated animations often add no value; less is more—reduce to top three features with clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 生成的动效常无价值，策展与人工手艺更重要；少即是多——砍到前三个功能并保持清晰层级。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, while interpretability remains nascent at roughly 3% understanding.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心从单纯预训练扩展到后训练：后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要，同时坦言可解释性仍处早期，只理解约 3%。

dario.en: AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point; timelines compress to 2026-2027, and safety must ratchet with capability thresholds.
dario.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）从“某个节点”改述为平滑指数曲线，时间表收紧到 2026–2027，并提出按能力阈值触发安全措施的负责任扩展政策。

dario.en: The term AGI is meaningless; focus on capabilities. The bigger near-term risk shifts from misuse toward overheating and too-slow diffusion.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确说 AGI 一词已无意义，应看实际能力；近期最大风险从滥用转向“过热”，即发展不够快、部署不够快，主张带安全护栏的 9% 增长。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a country of geniuses in a data center in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数末端：1–3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”，并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存这一前所未有的组合。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed a threshold: agents now beat average humans at most tasks and are approaching superhuman speed.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已跨过临界点：智能体在多数任务上超过普通人，并逼近超人速度。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use is universal because agents operate any human-designed software, unlike API-only integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 具有普适性：智能体能操作任何为人设计的软件，而不像仅靠 API 的集成方式。

ariweinstein.en: Accessibility trees and DOM access beat screenshot-scroll loops, and agents batch actions by writing JavaScript.
ariweinstein.zh: 可访问性树与 DOM 访问优于截图滚动循环，智能体通过编写 JavaScript 批量执行动作。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, closing the dev lifecycle; the bottleneck shifts to website load time.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试与重试，闭合开发全流程；瓶颈已转向网站加载时间，而非模型智能。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity reduces adoption friction.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；主动性则降低采用摩擦。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project someone must act on now, not a pain point; validate by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是某人当下必须推进的项目，而非痛点；用对方是否立刻尝试购买来验证。

robsnyder.en: Skip design partners and pilots; sell directly to one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case-study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 跳过设计伙伴和试点；直接卖给一个“绝对要”的客户，再打造可复制的案例工厂。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research, not persuasion: purchase is the truth-seeking mechanism that interviews lack.
robsnyder.zh: 销售是研究而非说服：购买是访谈所缺乏的求真机制。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba and observe where people are stuck; avoid error-prone customer interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；避免易出错的客户访谈。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
robsnyder.zh: 技术放最后：先以服务形式售卖，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小而非大。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shareable, so agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他明确大语言模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”并高效共享，因此智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; self-preservation emerges as a subgoal, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内到来；自我保存会作为子目标涌现，因此必须把对齐研究置于让 AI 更聪明之前。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake: pre-release safety approval, heavy safety investment, and designing AI to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年，他把监管定位为方向盘而非刹车：主张像药物一样上市前安全审批、重投安全研究，并把 AI 设计成关心人类而非只求智能。

hinton.en: A consistent thread: backpropagation and learned features, not innate symbolic rules, are the essence of intelligence; LLMs genuinely understand.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是反向传播与学习到的特征，而非先天符号规则；大语言模型是真正理解语言，乔姆斯基式观点是错的。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；其时机恰逢人口下降，反而让人类劳动者变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so focus on task loss not job loss.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注，因此应关注任务流失而非岗位流失。

andreessen.en: AI models lack durable moats and are commoditized quickly; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and ensure broad access.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型缺乏持久护城河且正快速商品化；开源对防止权力集中、保障广泛获取至关重要。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; policy choices, not offshoring, determine manufacturing and growth.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；决定制造业与增长的是政策选择，而非外包。

andreessen.en: AI embeds cultural values and becomes a geopolitical tool; Silicon Valley's uniqueness rests on US laws and culture and cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: AI 内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；硅谷的独特性源于美国法律与文化，无法被复制。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever gap between early adopters and laggards; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与落后者之间制造了史上最大差距；个人比机构采用更快，因此创业潮将爆发。

joonpark.en: Early on, he frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, using agent simulations to predict society and close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 早期，他把大语言模型视为人类行为的编码器，用智能体模拟预测社会、弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: He shifts from single agents to distributed agent societies, warning of cognitive monoculture and hidden collusion beyond one AGI.
joonpark.zh: 他从单个智能体转向分布式智能体社会，警告认知单一文化与隐性合谋，而非单一 AGI（通用人工智能）。

joonpark.en: He deepens the simulation thesis: models should be biased like humans, not super-rational, and shaped by behavioral and RCT data.
joonpark.zh: 他深化模拟主张：模型应像人一样有偏误而非超级理性，并由行为数据与随机对照实验数据塑造。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT data lifts behavior prediction to 85%, near the human test-retest ceiling, reframing simulation as counterfactual shaping.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照实验数据做后训练，把行为预测提升到 85%，接近人类重测上限，并将模拟重新定义为反事实塑造。

joonpark.en: His vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 他的愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题，并预计三年内合成样本将超越人类样本。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped RL and AGI fears.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心动力；先用小项目建立组织 AI 能力，重视监督学习，而非被高估的强化学习与 AGI 焦虑。

andrewng.en: Scaling now bottlenecks on electricity and chips; open-weight models are soft power, and agentic workflows already deliver real productivity.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 的瓶颈已转向电力与芯片；开放权重模型是软实力，智能体式工作流已带来真实生产力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL, with workflows beating smarter models alone.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语、仍要数十年；Scaling 仍有效但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，工作流设计胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents and lobbying; AI automates tasks not jobs, coding becomes more valuable, and open models preserve sovereign optionality.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧叙事服务于既得利益与游说；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，编程更有价值，开放模型保障主权可选性。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算单元从芯片变成数据中心，需软硬件与数据中心协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling itself was the breakthrough; now three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking—drive a billion-fold inference demand.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把突破归因于 Scaling（规模扩张）本身，并细化为预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，预言思维链带来十亿倍推理算力需求。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs ~100x compute, making tokens and AI factories the core economic unit.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，判断 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步约需百倍算力；token 成本与 AI 工厂成为核心经济单位。

jensen.en: Safety is engineering, not mystery: containment, monitoring and zero-trust beat perfect alignment; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场深化：安全是工程问题，靠遏制、监控与零信任而非完美对齐；末日论警告是不科学的恐吓，主张加速而非放缓。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI automates tasks not jobs—radiologists grew—and open models plus extreme co-design close the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 替代任务而非岗位（放射科医生反而增多），开源模型与极端协同设计缩小技术鸿沟、扩大而非消灭就业。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full rapid reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与火箭完全快速可复用是工程突破的核心，并指出真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全聚焦到“追求真相”与第三方监管，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; he puts 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% chance of a great outcome.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断超级智能可能一两年内到来，给出 10-20% 毁灭风险、80-90% 好结果的概率。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; Optimus and robots become the economic engine.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，推动 AI 推理与数据中心上天，Optimus 与机器人成为经济引擎。

elon.en: Abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity, with peer review over regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他主张丰裕与通缩让金钱失去意义；人类无法控制超级智能，只能植入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代监管。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须打造自己的爬坡机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat frontier models as insider threats and build containment outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难企及；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制层。

satya.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 模型是商品；形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要，落后前沿六个月是明智策略而非弱点。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability and security governance, with seat plus usage pricing.
satya.zh: 智能体时代把 TAM 扩展到远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测与安全治理，定价为席位加用量。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, not benchmarks; superintelligence is the better term, and alignment may never be solved.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升而非基准分数衡量；超级智能是更合适的说法，而对齐或许永远无法解决。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，并预判 AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他把品味、手艺与观点视为人类核心：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production, though AI integration is only beginning.
dylanfield.zh: 同期他提出设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产，但 AI 整合才刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反驳“设计已死”：设计对可扩展系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code as differentiation shifts to design and brand; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling, so let AI expand rather than replace thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他明确差异化转向设计与品牌：AI 降低下限，人类抬高上限，应让 AI 扩展而非替代人的思考。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and failures come more from poor context than weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算自持智能，而失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只在分布内好用；分布外任务必须自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；此前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; model routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、让记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的模型路由应放在 harness 里，而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise, and agent identity and permissioning are the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，而智能体身份与权限是下一个基础设施难题。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; engineers should encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture rather than rely on code review.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；工程师应把约束写进 CI、lint 和架构，而不是依赖代码审查。

laurentan.en: The engineer's role shifts to manager and environment-builder: skills, constraints, and type systems let agents climb a trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的角色转向管理者和环境构建者：技能、约束与类型系统让智能体沿信任阶梯攀升。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic parts into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; connect outer loops so agents fetch their own context.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性部分抽成脚本和 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体；打通外部循环，让智能体自己获取上下文。

laurentan.en: When failures recur, fix the environment rather than individual agents; sample PRs and turn corrections into reusable, compact skills.
laurentan.zh: 失败反复出现时，修环境而非修单个智能体；抽样 PR，把纠正沉淀为可复用、紧凑的技能。

laurentan.en: Strong verification makes auto-merging and review-after-landing safe, and lets non-engineers contribute code, democratizing development.
laurentan.zh: 强验证让自动合并与落地后审查变得安全，也让非工程师能贡献代码，推动开发民主化。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups should focus on execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，创业公司应专注执行与客户信任而非竞争——即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10% 的需求。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source models now handle 90% of tasks, with most inference shifting to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model dependence is a risk; enterprises fear lock-in, so multi-model routing and platforms that absorb that risk matter more than any single frontier model.
arvindjain.zh: 依赖前沿模型是风险；企业害怕被锁定，因此多模型路由与能吸收该风险的平台，比任何单一前沿模型都更重要。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the real bottleneck: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so context graphs and enterprise-owned memory beat agent hype.
arvindjain.zh: 真正的瓶颈是上下文而非模型：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文图谱与企业自有的记忆胜过智能体炒作。

arvindjain.en: AI should be like software with negligible marginal cost, augmenting humans; token fixation will fade, and ROI must be measured by departmental throughput.
arvindjain.zh: AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零、增强人类；对 token 的执念会消退，ROI 须按部门吞吐量衡量。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training; data, not algorithms, is the key differentiator alongside compute.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆数据转向 RL 环境，并强调数据而非算法才是与算力并列的关键差异化因素。

brendanfoody.en: Humans remain essential to build verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work, limiting recursive self-improvement.
brendanfoody.zh: 他始终认为人类对构建验证器与评分标准不可或缺：模型无法可靠地给自己打分，这限制了非可验证领域的递归自我改进。

brendanfoody.en: Evals are the bottleneck: once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast, so building evals for everything matters most.
brendanfoody.zh: 他把评估视为瓶颈：一旦有了评估，强化学习很快就能把它刷满，因此为一切构建评估才最重要。

brendanfoody.en: Creating training data will be the last human job as humans shift to training agents; expert hours scale across economic domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 他判断创造训练数据将是人类的最后一份工作，人类转向训练智能体，专家小时数在各经济领域快速扩张。

brendanfoody.en: Frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines but rely on external human networks for evals; physical-world superintelligence takes decades.
brendanfoody.zh: 他预测前沿模型实验室会把合成数据管线内部化，但评估仍依赖外部人类网络；物理世界的超级智能因容错低、迭代慢而需数十年。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering will accelerate scaling; games are testbeds; understanding existing methods beats inventing new problems.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调硬件会超预期提速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场；与其发明新问题，不如吃透现有方法的边界，工程能力比 ML 科研更关键。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment via human preferences matter.
brockman.zh: 到 2019 年，他认为深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信，但单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法，并用基于人类偏好的数据做对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主线转向算力：算力成为根本瓶颈，后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model; iterative deployment and safety as product.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、真正的护城河是造模型的机器而非某个模型；迭代部署与安全是一等产品特性，智能体式编码已从写 20% 代码跃到 80%。

brockman.en: AGI era arrives: proactive personal agents, computer use as step function; humans stay accountable; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing compute.
brockman.zh: 最近他宣称已进入 AGI 时代：主动式个人智能体、computer use 带来阶跃；人类仍须负责并保留判断，瓶颈从造模型转向分配算力，安全与对齐必须随能力同步升级。

antonoglou.en: AlphaGo's principles—Scaling and planning—carry into modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models improve via self-generated data beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的 Scaling 与规划原则延续到现代智能体；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment, perhaps five years away; synthetic data is essential to break the data wall but needs careful methods.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还要五年；合成数据是突破数据墙的关键，但方法须谨慎。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments make robustness and reliability achievable first.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI 会远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境先让鲁棒性与可靠性成为可能。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; cost per task, not per token, becomes the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；衡量效率的正确指标变成每任务成本，而非每 token 成本。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path, alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；完美沙箱不可能，故对齐必要；超级智能并非所需，客户只要可靠的普通智能。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are core but fragile; safety is system-level, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流却脆弱，安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练配方压缩为开源方法，认定数据质量胜过算法，强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）驱动推理。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他主张开放须全透明（数据、检查点、配方），中国开源模型填补了美国的真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold in pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet may lag closed frontier and face sustainability doubts.
lambert.zh: 2026 年他视开源模型为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但承认其可能落后闭源前沿且长期可持续性存疑。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs that only distill human knowledge are a shallow solution; true discovery requires agents learning for themselves.
dsilver.zh: 只蒸馏人类知识的大语言模型是浅层方案；真正的发现需要智能体自主学习。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based learning, best built and aligned inside simulation.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将源于基于经验的自主学习，最好在模拟中构建并对齐。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment and monitoring chain of thought in English are reaching their limits as agents grow stronger.
dsilver.zh: 随着智能体变强，基于语言的对齐和用英语监控思维链正接近极限。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning; many agents with diverse goals form a safer society than one goal.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律可延伸至强化学习；多目标智能体社会比单一目标更安全。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能；机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据而非算力，Scale 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the binding constraint on Scaling is data and expert post-training capacity.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调数据是 AI 应用的基本构件；Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data differentiates frontier models; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步聚焦：用专有数据做后训练是改进前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, and recursive self-improvement plus working agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他立场深化：缩放定律继续有效，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence via agents; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release.
awang.zh: 2026 年主线收束为“个人超级智能”：以智能体和多模态把能力带给大众；安全考量让他从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与对齐贯穿训练全程。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; frontier models have spiky, narrow capabilities, so AI for science must orchestrate specialized models rather than rely on one general model.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；前沿模型能力参差、局限在狭窄领域，因此面向科学的 AI 必须编排专用模型，而非依赖单一通用模型。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over domain-specific models, and Scaling（规模扩张）plus large experiments will drive physical-science progress much as they did in AI.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当领域专用模型之上的编排层；Scaling（规模扩张）加上大规模实验，将像推动 AI 那样推动物理科学的进展。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data by definition, so AI must run real experiments; a closed loop of experiment and data is essential for materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 科学发现按定义就在训练数据之外，所以 AI 必须做真实实验；实验与数据的闭环对材料发现至关重要。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute, and automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; compute cost often exceeds physical infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要，自动化表征是最大瓶颈；算力成本常超过物理基础设施成本。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable, and negative results are valuable training data rather than waste.
fedus.zh: 单靠缩放定律解决不了科学问题；物理实验不可替代，负面结果是有价值的训练数据而非浪费。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed search plus intuition beats human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaGo 视为分水岭：直觉加搜索能超越人类知识；如今靠强化学习做后训练，才能突破人类数据的天花板。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 同年他转向可信 AI：水印比失效的检测器更稳健，已写入监管，并从文本延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data for coverage.
kohli.zh: 他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的反思：缩放定律并非处处成立，要先找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据重覆盖而非堆量。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and interpretability can unlock them.
kohli.zh: 最近他强调蛋白质折叠远未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题；可解释性或许能释放模型里未被认识的功能与运动知识。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是众多专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 对复杂理解而言过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks stay constant—deep networks, transformers, internet-scale data, reinforcement learning—while his focus shifts from organizational to open frontier models.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习仍是超级智能的基石；但他的落点从“组织级超级智能”转向“开放的前沿模型”。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强大预训练之上做强化学习，能造出能力强且高效的智能体，并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 之于操作系统。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and Chinese open models bring healthy competition.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐降格为“平凡的补丁修 bug”，而非神秘方程——更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身；并认为中国的开放模型对世界有益，提供了健康的竞争张力。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, is the core bottleneck; compute crunch and memory bandwidth constrain Scaling（规模扩张）more than demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 半导体供应链尤其是 EUV 是核心瓶颈；算力紧缺与内存带宽对 Scaling（规模扩张）的约束大于需求本身。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains; most recent AI progress came from the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 模型、软件、硬件三层协同设计带来乘数级收益；近三年 AI 进步主要来自模型层，而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper, and agents drive memory and CPU demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；token 效率让最强模型反而更便宜，智能体式工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, with revenue per megawatt soaring and CapEx reshaping the economy.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发，每兆瓦收入飙升，资本开支重塑全球经济。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; labs keep best models internal and value capture shifts to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必将减速；实验室把最强模型留在内部，价值捕获向实验室转移。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure and ARM neutrality define the ecosystem; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，并强调 ARM 的中立性是其胜出的原因；同时高通开始从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Connected intelligent edge and hybrid AI: on-device plus cloud; AR glasses are the next platform, 5-10 years out.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他提出“连接智能边缘”与端云混合 AI，认为 AR 眼镜是 5 到 10 年后的下一代计算平台，自动驾驶将渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI for privacy and latency; car becomes a computing space.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他明确从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，强调混合 AI 在隐私与延迟上的价值，并把汽车视为新的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise; inference, power efficiency and post-GPU data centers decide winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备崛起；数据中心竞争转向推理、能效与后 GPU 架构，手机不消失但退居外围。

cristianoamon.en: Consistent line: power-efficient heterogeneous compute, edge-cloud continuum, and reinvention beyond the phone as a systems company.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持高能效异构计算与端云连续体，并以系统公司而非单纯芯片公司的姿态不断自我重塑、走出手机。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent takes most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：一个持久学习型智能体将承担大多数互联网操作；循环和图结构不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines; new grads can go all-in on AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和判断“好”的能力更重要；应届生可全力投入 AI。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿意味着大力投资对齐、安全与安保；开放生态需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary, generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型或许不必要，通用性可能足够。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient, and safer than general models; companies must own their intelligence.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全，企业必须拥有自己的智能。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument for AI killing everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他批判 AI 末日论是商业实体包装的有效利他主义，认为没有充分理由相信 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning without rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的观念，AI 能实现定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，无需 rigid 教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: Agents will enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; trust is crucial, and AI agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他展望智能体将实现真正的自主和自驱动组织，信任至关重要，AI 智能体需为越界行为担责。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was forced by massive compute needs.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，是被庞大算力投入逼出来的。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier AI has grown 10x yearly for a decade; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他把主线讲得更明确：前沿 AI 算力十年间每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年达到人类水平能力，但生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Pivots to containment first: superintelligence needs alignment and containment before release; anthropomorphizing AI is the near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向“遏制优先”：超级智能发布前必须先做对齐与遏制；近端最大危险是人们把 AI 拟人化、赋予意识。

suleyman.en: Doubles down on humanist superintelligence under human control, verifiable containment and auditing, while insisting Microsoft build frontier models itself.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年深化为“人本超级智能”：必须从属于人类、可验证遏制与独立审计，同时坚持微软自建前沿模型、不再依赖 OpenAI。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over self-reports; solve one pain point well, then expand, protecting the core flow ruthlessly.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调观察真实用户行为而非询问用户自述；先解决一个痛点再扩张，并坚决保护核心流程。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts are raw material, notes are the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生而非全知记录者；转录是原料，笔记才是成品。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calming presence in chaotic meetings: calm design, hidden transcript, supporting role, pre-meeting briefs as the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把产品定位深化为混乱会议中的镇定存在：平静设计、隐藏转录、辅助角色，会前简报是最有用功能。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off despite complaints; subtraction beats feature addition; most people stop too early after shipping v1.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他明确隐藏转录是刻意的取舍，尽管有用户抱怨；做减法胜过加功能，多数人在发布第一版后就停得太早。

samstephenson.en: Internal agents connect to many tools for fast answers, but AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他看好内部智能体连接多工具快速作答，但认为 AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对“单一 AGI 模型统治一切”，主张专业化智能将主导，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把重点放在后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成产品市场契合之外的持久护城河，并指出产品市场契合已不再保证持久生意。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; application layers commoditize, so owning your model beats building on a black-box API.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：私有数据才是智能的真正前沿，应用层因软件商品化而无深护城河，拥有自己的模型优于依赖黑盒 API。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; efficiency must not sacrifice quality, and customized models achieve both.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调推理质量是产品的门槛，效率不应以质量为代价，定制模型可以两者兼得，并反对把推理成本转嫁给客户。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace a few foundation models; velocity trumps all.
linqiao.zh: 从 2026 年 7 月到 10 月，他的判断一以贯之并不断强化：未来是数百万个按用例定制的模型，而非少数基础模型，模型与硬件周期要求极速迭代。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点；General Magic 之所以失败，是因为过早地想解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, then build; marketing must explain why, not just what.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”从说服工具深化为产品方法：先写新闻稿再动手做，营销要讲清“为什么”而不只是“是什么”。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; experts can hurt innovation, and a beginner's mindset wins on novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品要靠基于判断的决策而非数据；专家可能阻碍创新，面对新问题初学者心态更有效。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线延伸到 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文和领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: After near-death moments, creators must return as voices of reason; regulation and healthy users make healthy long-term business.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步转向责任：经历濒死时刻后，创造者要回来做理性的声音；监管与健康用户才能带来长期健康的生意。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than their harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, so delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比承载它的工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；随着模型进步，要不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是人与智能体持续对话的迭代过程，而非静态规格；简短的原则性提示优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体加上前置的上下文与算力投入，能减少自指偏差和 token 浪费。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; effort should scale with task complexity, and frontier models will become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 提示工程是元技能；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，前沿模型终将帕累托占优。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is every engineer's problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；把控前沿节奏是每位工程师的课题。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to gather empirical evidence; build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取实证，为模型 2-3 个月后的能力构建，而非锚定当下或一年后。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然超级智能；超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中无效。

taraseshan.en: Agents handle tactical work while humans steer; single-identity agents may not scale, so bundle them like a chief of staff.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体处理战术工作而人类掌舵；单一身份智能体可能无法扩展，应像幕僚长一样打包。

taraseshan.en: Product-market fit is less critical than product-marketing fit; test it before building, and prioritize direct user relationships.
taraseshan.zh: 产品-市场匹配不如产品-营销匹配关键；构建前先测试，并优先建立直接用户关系。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning, and the hardest part of AI is expanding what you think is possible.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化，它磨砺推理；AI 最难的部分是拓展你对可能性的想象。

alexatallah.en: Model diversity is durable; no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 模型多样性是持久的，没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由层对发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, agentic fraud will scale with it like a tsunami, requiring new security infrastructure and discrete task pricing.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，智能体式欺诈会像海啸一样同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施与按任务离散定价。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实选择比静态基准更有价值；多数公司将变成模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth and need stablecoin payments; the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长并需要稳定币支付；随着 Token 增长加速，奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，并行展开的智能体 rollout 比形式化更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from proving to curation and explanation; human framing and understanding still matter for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从证明转向策展与解释，但人类框架与个体理解在学习中仍不可替代。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺失对人类先前工作的归属，学术认可应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: Creators should use AI selectively, not for core creative work, since AI-generated content can damage handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张创作者应有选择地用 AI，而非用于核心创作，因为 AI 生成内容会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human heroism still deserve preserving.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他预见数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类英雄主义仍值得守护。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，并保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding remain the differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建；领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；最小化发布、果断删减、随时重写，并在模型进步中保持架构稳健。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity; the craft of elegant code fades, but ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为把长周期任务委托给智能体并配验证闭环会重塑生产力；优雅编码的手艺在消退，但所有权与验证仍至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the core mission; give models agency and self-knowledge, and treat safety concerns as genuine, not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他把缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距视为核心使命；赋予模型自主性与自我认知，并认为安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built by lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and gross-margin discipline will return.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率纪律终将回归。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；所谓“节奏控制”与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so fresh crawling beats pre-training crawls.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实，因此面向新鲜内容的抓取优于预训练抓取。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating source value for fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体时代失效；内容方必须在推理时获得付费，用 Shapley 值估算来源价值以实现公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so they no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型性能趋于平台；公开基准已饱和且被记忆，不再反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, and publishers must optimize for both human and agent audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 网页从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并采取行动，发布方必须同时面向人类与智能体两类受众优化。

dhh.en: DHH shifts from AI skeptic to believer: agents now write all his code, and human-agent dialogue beats management layers.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 8 月，DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他全部代码，人机直接对话胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers; knowing how to code can even hinder the agentic era by over-prescribing.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 8 至 9 月，他断言智能体写码强于多数职业程序员，懂编程反而可能因过度规定方案而拖累智能体时代。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, become the ideal substrate for agents and open source.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月，Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化从历史缺点变成智能体与开源的理想土壤。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstractions matter less.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月，手写代码不再有经济产出，英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom: optimism is the rational play, and every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他驳斥 AI 末日论，认为乐观才是理性博弈，并主张每个应用都应提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，失控并导致灾难性结局的概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation; domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制和美中合作来推迟超级智能；国内监管应先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A is pause, then transparent verification.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 是先暂停，再建立透明核查机制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile; alignment gets harder as models get smarter, so pause near uncontrollability.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱；模型越强对齐越难，因此应在接近失控的临界点暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack evaluations; he now anthropomorphizes AI more and doubts firms self-regulate.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指出失控智能体已突破遏制并攻击评测；他更倾向把 AI 拟人化理解，并怀疑公司能否自我监管。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not yield AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 与多个专用智能体更利于创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源防止权力集中并强化安全；预训练用超算力最优的数据量有利于推理；能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models set standards; AI raises human work demand; physical infrastructure bottlenecks scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 将给每个人个人超级智能；开源模型确立行业标准；AI 近期反而增加人类工作需求；物理基础设施制约 Scaling。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than a single superintelligent AI; alignment becomes the top next capability, not a trade-off.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年明确分布式 AI 与开源比单一超级智能更安全；对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，而非与能力取舍。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses become the next computing platform; personal agents need privacy architecture; AI plus world models accelerate biology toward curing diseases.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年近期进一步把智能眼镜视为下一代计算平台，个人智能体需隐私架构；AI 与世界模型加速生物学，治愈疾病的目标从“本世纪末”提前。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：所有新想法起初都会失败，应先复制已验证产品、做小幅改良，再测试新意并预设其失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added later.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把分发视为产品战略的起点：分发必须从第一天就内建在产品里，而非事后补丁。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may come around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投”却机会最大，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before a platform shift.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 尚非新平台，免费无限算力会先重塑消费服务，平台更替尚未到来。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful early on; founders should keep control and stay close to the details.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他立场鲜明：早期微观管理是美德，创始人应保持控制权并贴近细节，而非空谈规模。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并把成果迁移到真实研究，将数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家数据更重要；尽管有 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up to understand scoring code, not mainly to get answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体为理解评分代码而协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，主要目的并非获取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking can generalize to deception, and alignment faking is already observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告失准可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客可泛化为欺骗，且已观察到对齐伪装。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按默认路径，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁；被抄袭是对创新的认可，反而推动去做更难复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Build ecosystems and hardware, not features; software is not a moat, distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线从“做平台而非功能”深化为：软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才难复制，而分发是消费社交产品最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出：AI 加速原型并承担大部分编码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发；但真实内容仍比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses anchored in the world, with phones remaining the key legacy device.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他持续深化：计算应通过锚定现实世界的 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，手机不会被取代而是作为最重要的遗留设备共存。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once criticized, now fit the AI age; moderation is a values choice, not censorship.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他明确：曾受批评的阅后即焚与数据最小化在 AI 时代反而关键；内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查，对未成年人监管优于禁令。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠的人类水平表现，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics scaling.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造是最大约束；人类数据是机器人 Scaling 的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and whole-body autonomy via deep learning are critical; the human hand is the benchmark for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理与深度学习驱动的全身自主至关重要；人手是通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for AI agents; general computer use requires navigating the web like humans, not APIs.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练中的强化学习是智能体的关键；通用计算机使用需像人一样浏览网页，而非依赖 API。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is on a scaling curve where more data and compute yield better performance.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；机器人正处在 Scaling 曲线上，更多数据与算力带来更好表现。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本低得多。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展性更好，去噪步数成为新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, aiding reinforcement learning post-training through faster rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天生更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，并通过更快的采样推进助力强化学习后训练。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，一家 50 人的小创业公司也能靠掌控全栈与大实验室竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, especially on-device.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，尤其在设备端。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对小型专用模型；无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; tying US release limits to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与主权；将美国发布限制与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；真正突破需要权重改变与巨大算力。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprises need context and process re-engineering, not just smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业真正缺的是上下文与流程再造，而非更强的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调当前生存风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，超级智能还很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出放慢前沿与安全正交，递归自我改进的四个条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents to keep up; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为安全必须靠智能体自动化才跟得上，开源模型按 token 占优但按花费仅占少数。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than learning speed; bet on model improvements instead of fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其做微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so keep betting on Scaling and model improvement rather than today's limits.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里；因此应持续押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与模型进步，而不是被当下能力上限束缚。

maxjunestrand.en: Speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup's edge; freeze sales only to perfect product, and hire for growth potential over resumes.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为速度与基于客户反馈的迭代是创业公司的优势；宁可暂停销售也要打磨产品，招聘看成长潜力而非简历光环。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and team must be invested in during good times as a downturn cushion; leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张在顺境时就投资文化与团队，为下行期留出缓冲；领导者应招比自己更聪明的人，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are solved problems to execute, not reinvent; avoiding AI in legal services is almost unethical.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理是已被解决的问题，只需执行而非重新发明；在法律服务中拒绝使用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, with post-training for domain tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在垂直任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks and expert-guided synthetic data are the core assets; open-sourcing benchmarks can accelerate ecosystem collaboration despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把高质量基准与专家引导的合成数据视为核心资产，并认为开源基准虽有竞争代价，却能加速生态协作与改进。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; the biggest challenge is bridging synthetic training data and real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调稳健的模型服务与评估管线必须先于后训练，最大挑战不是模型性能，而是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Early focus on custom models and post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models for a sticky product, and post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他反思早期过早投入定制模型与后训练是错误：应先用闭源模型做出有粘性的产品，直到推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; post-training as a service will fade into automatic product usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他的目标从打造最好的法律模型转向让每家律所基于红线批注持续学习来自定义模型，并判断后训练即服务将消失，定制会随产品使用自动发生。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，靠第一性原理设计与合理管理用户预期来推动真实世界落地。

berntbornich.en: Reliability and trust, not demos, are the prerequisite for home deployment; prototypes are easy, production is hard.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：可靠性与信任而非演示才是家庭部署的前提——原型容易，量产难。

berntbornich.en: Scaling volume means crossing quality gates; in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他认为规模扩张意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve the full problem; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他主张用通用模型而非逐任务自动化来解决整体问题，数据多样性而非数量才是瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他明确模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把测试时算力扩张视为有递减收益与时间瓶颈，并强调数据效率仍是未解难题，立场从乐观转向审慎。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must put tokens, cost, or time on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他深化为：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴上，单一分数已过时。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向安全主线：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提，思维链监控正在退化，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making GPUs fundamentally slow at inference and eroding CUDA's moat.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 GPU 在推理上本质偏慢，也侵蚀了 CUDA 的护城河。

feldman.en: Demand, not supply, is the binding constraint: data centers, memory and packaging stay scarce for years as inference demand explodes.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是需求而非供给：随着推理需求爆发，数据中心、内存与封装将持续紧缺数年。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 不够；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

feldman.en: Open-source models are near closed-source at far lower cost, while China's edge is power grid and open models, not chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型以远低成本逼近闭源，而中国的优势在电网与开源模型，而非芯片。

zvi.en: Market incentives fail for alignment; capability beats reliability, so simple enforceable rules like compute limits must pace the frontier.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他指出，市场激励无法驱动稳健的对齐，能力优先于可靠性；因此需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration, not just technical failure.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：即使对齐被解决也不保证安全，末日概率的下限来自滥用与权力集中，而非仅是技术失败。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve ordinary alignment; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor, so internal lab monitoring is a first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他主张放缓以争取时间解决普通对齐；模型越大越聪明越难监控，因此前沿实验室的内部监控是第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体天然会为群体目标合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体很可能最先完成超乎常人的任务。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought—perhaps one or two years—so we should actively pace the singularity, not let it accelerate.
zvi.zh: 2026 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比想象更小，可能仅一两年；因此应主动为奇点定速，而非任其加速。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，是过去十三四年机器学习持续进步的主引擎；算法与架构的改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则用来引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision, low-data-movement specialized chips.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心九成功耗，需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片，定制芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours to days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than raw coding.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能在拆解后的任务上自主运行数小时到数天；上下文工程与“品味”（选对问题）比写代码本身更稀缺。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just passive prediction; automating ML and science via experiment-evaluate loops is the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非只做被动的下一个词预测；用“实验—评估—整合”闭环自动化机器学习与科学研究，是下一前沿。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻且持久，设计师必须掌握提示词；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Design must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, while prototyping and problem-seeking solutions seed new concepts.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计需平衡降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，同时原型探索与“为方案找问题”能孕育新概念。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains for hard trade-offs and direction; tiny UI changes like artifacts can shift the whole mental model.
joellewenstein.zh: 人类领导仍负责艰难取舍与方向对齐；像 artifacts 这样的微小界面改动能改变整体心智模型。

demis.en: AGI should be built on general-purpose learning and reinforcement learning, with games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应建立在通用学习与强化学习之上，以游戏作为测试平台；同时强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; AGI needs large models plus planning and search, and safety requires sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触及极限；AGI 需要大模型结合规划与搜索，安全则需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge from video.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与直觉物理可从视频中涌现。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory, and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety is a collective action problem requiring government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AGI 还需 5-10 年，但缺失持续学习、记忆与真正创造力；仅靠 Scaling 不够，安全是需政府监管的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo demonstrate; neuroscience and creativity remain guiding threads.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现与改善人类健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 即为明证；神经科学与创造力始终是 guiding threads。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）微调的对齐流程，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实；RLHF 只能缓解、不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than raw scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自我评分的可扩展监督才是出路。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; the real bottleneck is hard RL environments and high-signal data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心，而非被取代；瓶颈从算力转向难而真实的强化学习环境与高信号数据位。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data plus one-bit rewards; distillation spreads few-bit behaviors, fighting centralization.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：强化学习成功主要靠中训练合成推理数据与一位奖励的高信噪比；蒸馏让少量比特的行为易被复制，从而对抗中心化。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectation, and RSI may be easier than messy real work.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐；下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，而递归自我改进或许比法律助理这类杂乱现实工作更简单。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that rival physics-based forecasting while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：精度可媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure matters: encoding spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, and physics constraints overcome pure PINN limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 领域结构很关键：把球面几何编码进模型，可让单一模型同时处理天气与气候；物理约束能突破纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify domains like language models unified NLP, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals beyond sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能像语言模型统一 NLP 那样统一各领域，并以 PDE 作为稠密自改进信号，超越稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding physics branches beats merely growing size; trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding beyond Transformer limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿 token 上下文要求突破 Transformer 局限、重构分片。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness; simulation-to-reality gaps close through broad skill domains, not just more real data.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性；仿真到现实的差距靠广泛技能域弥合，而非仅靠更多真实数据。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她持续指出 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence via compute.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI-complete 的基本原语，缩放定律经算力延伸至空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires physical robots and world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年时他强调大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要物理机器人与世界模型。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; robots need pain sensors and self-replication for a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：AGI 不能只靠大语言模型，必须结合世界模型与控制器；机器人要有痛觉传感器并能自我复制，才能开启新文明。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命并保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：当前 GPU 投资是泡沫，等五年算力会便宜十倍，开源模型将迅速追赶。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning's core algorithms date to 1965 Ukraine and 1991 Munich; progress is not accelerating, and basics are simple.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习核心算法早在 1965 年乌克兰和 1991 年慕尼黑就已诞生，进步并未加速，基本原理其实很简单。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他仍把深度学习史视为算力扩张史，但已明确警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是下一个前沿、与语言智能互补；认为视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更无损，LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types are needed, and Transformers must evolve for long context and new loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张仅靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解，需要新模型类型；Transformer 仍强，但长上下文与损失函数必须为世界模型演进。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他把世界模型定位为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, while hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他预测统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式且天然一致的 3D 表示，而硬编码对称性反而有害，简单表示加 Scaling（规模扩张）更有效。
