tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just offer broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability is moving from academia to products, with platforms broadening access.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；可解释性正从学术界走向产品，平台让更多人得以使用。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves from open-loop to closed-loop control, using interpretability signals to steer models; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计从开环控制走向闭环控制，用可解释性信号引导模型；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试是有前景的技术。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack, detectable via representational signatures; models can know they hallucinate yet proceed, due to ordering or personas.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客，这可通过表征特征检测；模型也能知道自己产生幻觉却照做，原因在于操作顺序或人格设定。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are not dead but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods may better capture structure, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器并未消亡，但会切碎流形；基于流形的方法可能更好地捕捉结构，而偏离流形进行引导会导致失败。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment; even with short timelines, accelerating interpretability beats pragmatic band-aids.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准；即便时间线很短，加速可解释性研究也胜过务实的权宜之计。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats commercial ERP.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，自建内部软件优于商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; restoring vision proves substrate independence and reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为 BCI，恢复视觉验证了基质独立性并降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: Brains and AI models share Platonic representations; the ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck limits BCI bandwidth.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出大脑与 AI 模型共享柏拉图式表征，约 10 比特/秒的认知瓶颈限制了 BCI 带宽。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国的 AI 领导力需要一个活跃的开源与闭源生态，配以单一国家框架，且不设很快过时的刚性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; regulate model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 诞生、如今已过时；应监管模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid alarm-driven containment.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告未见兑现——因此政策不应被恐慌驱动的遏制思路主导。

michaelkratsios.en: Science has been politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or dogma.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构或教条。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific output has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科研产出在经费增至三倍的情况下仍停滞；Genesis 计划用 AI 赋能科学以让产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: China is the major competitor in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio; centralized funding fails, so the US must win through free-market competition.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是 AI、量子、核能与生物领域的主要竞争者；集中式资助行不通，美国须靠自由市场竞争取胜。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalists that beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据能产出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve: unlike LLMs, it lacks predictable scaling laws, so generalization—not demos—is the core challenge to measure and solve.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放曲线之前：与 LLM 不同，它还没有可预测的缩放定律，因此核心挑战是可度量、可解决的泛化能力，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Data strategy inverted: start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top—not the reverse—and scale the right thing via a deployment data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 数据策略反转：先以真实具身机器人数据为起点，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；并通过部署数据飞轮扩张正确的对象。

slevine.en: Safety shifts from hard constraints to pre-training common sense; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale, and autonomous robots can outperform human-directed ones.
slevine.zh: 安全从硬性约束转向预训练常识；规模化下触觉感知可能与视觉冗余，自主机器人表现可超过人类指挥。

slevine.en: Reject robots as mechanical people: expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, with the AI/controls line drawn by whether the environment outside the robot must be modeled.
slevine.zh: 反对把机器人当作机械人：应期待日常物体普遍具备物理执行能力，AI 与控制的界线在于是否必须建模机器人之外的环境。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在做尽可能最快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室不是近期愿景；领域专家仍留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将在大量人类参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，促成了领域间的交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵不仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映射了非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只以最终效果来评判。

felixrieseberg.en: Building a small language model from scratch makes core ideas accessible; fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从零构建一个小语言模型能让核心思想变得可理解；与漫长的预训练不同，微调快速且有力地引导模型行为。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are stateless; persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows. They are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型是无状态的，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉；它们像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；理解模型内部有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as the medium and the model itself as the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与实时模型一起构建，把 token 和对话当作媒介，把模型本身当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design's job is to bridge that gap through systems thinking.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比产品暴露出来的更多；设计的职责是通过系统思维弥合这一差距。

iansilber.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts, prototyping functional builds rather than static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少待在 Figma，多研究模型行为和系统提示词，做可运行的原型而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter more than polishing details.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建比打磨细节更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a strong product designer, yet humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view; roles blur but specialize at scale.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可替代；角色在融合，规模化时仍会分化。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，只调整权重。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：以目标为导向、从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：持续从真实经验学习才是关键，合成数据与后训练是歧路，LLM 只是智能的一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人取胜；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be resilient and hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须坚韧、硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with a new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode and direct communication both serve internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与直接沟通都服务于内部正确而非外部认可。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can match huge headcount, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；借助智能体的小型自治团队可匹敌庞大编制，开放权重模型则制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will take about 20 years to change.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 进展慢于研究者预期，影响才刚触及商业，社会转变约需 20 年——这被他视为好事。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, with owned context and skill files as your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”：它不是单一事件，而是跑在自己基础设施上的智能体，自有上下文与技能文件构成护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skills become employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish within a decade.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 技能文件即“员工”，中层管理应由智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 或将在十年内消失。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与共享数据是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他把开源与安全解耦：开源与否并非关键，随着模型能力增强，对齐才是决定性的安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests, so monitoring via reasoning traces is weakening.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他强调，缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，而思维链式的推理痕迹越来越难监控。

thomaswolf.en: He now favors a deliberate slowdown, arguing openness and open science can coexist with safety rather than accelerationism.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年他转而主张有意的放缓，认为开放与开放科学可以和审慎安全并存，而非加速主义。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training for success rate and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出：来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中主导成功率与速度的提升。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重点转向可靠性：物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调；机器人自身经验数据不可替代，看人类演示远远不够。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass behind creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是创作决策背后的本能罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through first-time-pass silicon and deep listening, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠一次流片成功和深度倾听客户来重建信任，并以专用芯片和类似初创团队的独立团队推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将十倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, humility, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责、谦逊与客户导向上，并强调坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, new materials, advanced packaging—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张半导体投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热、新材料与先进封装等瓶颈，并认为 Intel 的垂直整合创造更多价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱，绝不直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k monthly.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能不可持续，每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best work: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动最好的作品：修掉让你烦的东西，活在未来，去建缺失之物，而不是追求企业式的精致。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻智能体本质是 token 问题。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网页本身很杂乱，一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必始终作为一个整体行动，保留个人印记和多元声音反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products; balance intuition with data, letting vision guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，并在直觉与数据之间取得平衡，让愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的实践转向 AI 工具：Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目，设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being early beats polishing, and models still lack taste.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；宁可不舒服地早到，也不追求打磨，而模型仍缺乏品味，人类应靠数量与思考补足。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Lossless optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding differ from lossy quantization; quantization can be calibrated to specific workloads for real gains.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码等无损优化不同于有损量化；量化可针对特定负载校准，带来实际收益。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving toward disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management increasingly central as inference merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，随着推理与训练融合，KV 缓存管理日益核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs and specialized systems; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration, yet human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 与专用系统；推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排，但人的责任仍不可或缺。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用层 AI，而前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but token usage is not a value metric; outcomes matter.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为编码智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者，但 token 消耗不是价值指标，业务结果才重要。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI markets will be driven by specialized vendors, not only model providers; incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：应用层 AI 市场将由专业厂商推动而非仅靠模型提供方，传统巨头面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全观明确为负责任地迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI is a democratizing force expanding access to expertise; it will create more jobs than it displaces, contrary to fixed-sum pessimism.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 是普及专业能力的民主化力量，并将创造多于取代的就业，而非零和悲观论。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so product work shifts from specs to prototyping with evals.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，产品开发因此从写规格转向用评估驱动的原型制作。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她判断随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的领域。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed to capture creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的人类判断，需要多样且持续的基准来衡量创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警示前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛为单一默认口吻。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考素材迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，必须给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The biggest opportunity of our lifetime lets one person do what once took teams, so start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 一生中最大的技术机会让一个人完成过去一个团队的事，所以要在准备好之前就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying across many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而不是分散服务许多低付费客户。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear in disguise; launch at 80% complete, iterate on real feedback, and fund with clients rather than venture capital.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是伪装的恐惧；在完成 80% 时发布，依据真实反馈迭代，并用客户收入而非风险投资来支撑业务。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; Claude Code empowers non-coders; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标，Claude Code 对非程序员价值更大，AGI 应以智能体能否无限期经济盈利来定义。

danshipper.en: From tool adoption to agent management: everyone gets an agent, but agents need caring human oversight; the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从工具采用转向智能体管理：人人都会有智能体，但自动化仍需人类照看与框定；所谓“AI 就业末日”是谎言，人类仍在创造新价值。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; CLIs are over, and users bring their own AI rather than SaaS embedding it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他判断工作界面转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类 GUI，CLI 已过时；用户会自带 AI，而非依赖 SaaS 内嵌 AI，SaaS 不会消亡。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset and craft; automation commoditizes frozen competencies and creates more expert human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与手艺；自动化把“冻结的能力”商品化，反而创造更多需要专家的新工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent thread: AI remains tool-like, requiring human taste, direction and oversight; humans stay smarter and meaning-making.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具式的，需要人的品味、方向与监督；人类仍更聪明，并负责赋予意义，即便超级智能也需人类反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so containment matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此遏制很重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则；通才工程师备受重视。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；100% 的代码由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出为“构建者”。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential productivity; loops and routines become the next abstraction layer after agents.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体带来指数级生产力提升；循环与例程成为智能体之后的下一抽象层。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; alignment and safety research are core to product development, not just commercial goals.
boris.zh: 安全通过尽早发布来研究；对齐与安全研究是产品开发的核心，而不仅是商业目标。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most system prompts and code; give slightly too hard tasks and let models self-verify.
boris.zh: 面对前沿模型，删除大部分系统提示与代码；给予稍难的任务并让模型自我验证。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption through hands-on, small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 靠小团队亲手实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development rather than documents.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，而非写文档。

diannepenn.en: Model taste comes from creative prototyping; maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型品味来自创造性原型；最大化 token 消耗是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline where cells can be programmed.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100% 有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer become engineering problems solved by AI.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度；逆转衰老与 100% 治愈癌症成为由 AI 解决的工程问题。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, merging via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不用它才是不道德；医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact is in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is urgently needed there.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅汽车；这些领域急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years, not technology; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断最难的是技术多年间扩散到现有机器，而非技术本身；监管总是滞后于技术。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so the hard part is the human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的难点是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI coding increases programmer demand; Devin works as a junior engineer under human oversight, not a replacement.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论论证 AI 编程会带来更多程序员需求；Devin 更像被人类监督的初级工程师，而非替代者。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也还有十年产品空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions rather than full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限而非完全自主，同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他称编程智能体半年增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代临近但奇点并不迫近。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是像电一样的使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and invented use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用、由创业者发明用例。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming telecom-like: huge capex, low profits.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值上移到应用层，模型提供方可能沦为电信式角色：巨额算力投入、微薄利润。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption takes years, not weeks, because it requires reimagining workflows; current usage stays shallow and ROI is hard to measure.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要数年而非数周，因为要重构工作流；当前使用仍然很浅，投资回报难以衡量。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably—accountants grew through the 20th century—so predicting which jobs AI replaces is futile; the hard part is context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以不可预测的方式创造新工作——会计人数在整个 20 世纪反而增长——因此预测 AI 取代哪些岗位是徒劳的；工作的难点在于上下文与判断。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and every output is a hallucination lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎：流畅输出优先于事实准确，每次输出都是幻觉，系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key weakness lagging breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是落后于广度与语境性的关键短板；它必须被架构进系统，而非靠事后检查或僵化工作流补丁式加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity must carry progress beyond Scaling（规模扩张）.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此思维链、搜索与模块化必须接过 Scaling（规模扩张）之后的进展。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言结构或作为有用表示回归。

danbiderman.en: Memory must move from external context/retrieval into model weights; continual learning is the next frontier, not raw intelligence.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆必须从外部上下文/检索转向模型权重内部化；持续学习是下一个前沿，而非原始智能。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, challenging pure Scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，挑战纯粹的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning model weights; many small models beat one frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有模型权重；许多小模型胜过单个前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should apply to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can outperform RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔力应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可超越 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, with user feedback.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”；模型应自主学会在权重与文本间存储什么，并借助用户反馈。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily, as product taste becomes the key skill.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布，产品品味成为关键技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation, focusing on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师委托实现，专注于产品品味和商业意识；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬约束缩减了 80%，依赖模型判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写现在可行；代码库就是规范，有了好的测试套件，重写没问题。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks; humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 在提示注入和数据泄露风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；外层变更的代码审查应移除人类。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; managerial skills beat technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专业化智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can orchestrate AI agents as a team, but must retain human accountability for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排，但必须对 AI 生成的内容保留人类问责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; bootstrapping designs a business serving the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场匹配与挣来的洞察才是真正护城河；自举创业让生意服务于你想要的生活。

clairevo.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma remain irreplaceable.
clairevo.zh: 大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，人类必须提供新想法；影响力与魅力仍不可替代。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone won't yield world models with common sense and causality.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律无法产生具备常识与因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略举措：它商品化互补层并加速集体进步，而不只是理想主义。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; avoid over-dependence on any single third-party model.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单一模型时代已结束；应避免过度依赖任何单一第三方模型。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; AI should maximize individuals and free time for authentic human connection.
bosworth.zh: 大多数工作不需要前沿智能；AI 应最大化个体能力，并为真实人际连接腾出时间。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习依靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型可靠性与对齐是真正难题。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas and sample efficiency matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们回到研究时代，想法与样本效率比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；并设下具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力参差不齐，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching as models move toward end-to-end research; evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks, and models still lack research taste.
markchen.zh: 随着模型走向端到端研究，AGI 正在逼近；评测陷入危机、基准饱和，而模型仍缺乏研究品味。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员构建应用，纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静源于内心。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users and erode ad margins; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1% 会复利放大；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户、压低广告利润；要做自己痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended, models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration beats the model itself.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排比模型本身更重要。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, bottleneck 24/7 agents; local compute is the fix; chat ads corrupt trust.
aravind.zh: 制约 24/7 智能体的是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法；聊天广告会侵蚀信任。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已不再关键，AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layered defenses; jailbreaks are a fundamental security flaw.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的安全观从依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御，视越狱为根本性安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Bigger models are not safer; capability does not correlate with robustness; automated red teaming beats humans.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调更大的模型并不更安全，能力与鲁棒性不相关，自动化红队测试已胜过人类。

kolter.en: Agent security adds prompt injection risks; the lethal trifecta and configurable guardrails define enterprise adoption.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体安全带来提示注入风险，致命三要素与可配置护栏决定企业采用。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大深度或参数。

bengio.en: Biological networks excel at long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations, not just Scaling（规模扩张）.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他指出生物神经网络擅长长程信用分配；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理和解耦表征，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样和抽象，以支持分布外泛化；不确定性和主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observable; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，他警告对齐失败和自我保存行为已可观测；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI 和全球协调。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, as a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习，作为通往安全超级智能的路径。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；完美的可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove success—opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功源于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），与“苦涩教训”相反；进步来自许多中等突破而非孤立的重大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AI in science narrows hypothesis space and enables resource-limited scientists; trust will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：科学 AI 缩小假设空间并赋能资源有限地区的科学家；信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership means dogfooding, live one-on-ones, and realistic war rooms that protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力意味着吃自己的狗粮、用一对一进行实时对话，以及设定现实预期、保护团队士气的作战室。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程产能不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts to just-in-time; six-month roadmaps and design docs give way to AI-assisted PRs as source of truth.
fiona.zh: 规划转向即时化；六个月路线图与设计文档让位于作为事实来源的 AI 辅助 PR。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat teams and high agency with accountability replace throughput hiring.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平团队与高自主高担责取代以吞吐量为导向的招聘。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; verification and quality frameworks matter more, and non-engineers ship code as roles blur.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；验证与质量框架更重要，角色边界模糊，非工程师也开始交付代码。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs new ideas beyond scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，而常识无法靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决，需要全新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划，主张以 JEPA 和开源为路径，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models predicting in abstract representation space.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破要靠非生成式、在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他立场深化为 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，主张带内在约束的目标驱动世界模型与分层规划更安全，并预言下一个十年属于机器人。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence that data cannot replace, and technology should blend into the home.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能，科技应无缝融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: A consistent thread: we are feeling creatures that think, so design should amplify humanity; nature is the best designer and sustainability a core problem.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年一以贯之的主线：人是先感受后思考的生物，设计应放大而非削弱人性；自然是最好的设计师，可持续性是核心问题。

ivyross.en: By 2024 he deepens this into sensory systems: machines have sensors but no sensory systems, and art and museum visits become medicine.
ivyross.zh: 到 2024 年，他把这一主线深化为感官系统论：机器有传感器却没有感官系统，艺术创作与参观博物馆甚至成为一剂良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity, a view carried from 2024 into 2026, where he adds that leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力，这一观点从 2024 年延续到 2026 年，并进一步提出领导者要为玩耍与灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Most recently he frames the future of work as human creativity combined with AI, with intuition and body sensations as valid guides alongside rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 最近在 2026 年，他把未来工作定义为人类创造力与 AI 的结合，并认为直觉与身体感受和理性分析一样是有效的决策指引。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were not obvious; deploying AI in the real world with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 并获取公众反馈，对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, and RLHF inserts human values rather than revealing inherent ones.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是把一小群人的价值观塞进模型，而非模型自带的。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation, so products need fault-tolerant UIs matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，产品必须重做；机器学习产品要用容错界面去匹配算法当前的能力。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and two-way; by 2025 the real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, not hype.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他一贯认为生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话；到 2025 年更明确：大公司当下的 AI 收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost will force business-model change; Spotify should expose data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can build with AI.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他强调推理的边际成本会倒逼商业模式改变，并主张用 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具开发。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is the key bet.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，这是反共识的下注；技术剧变期风险与机会并存，抢先采用变化才是关键。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向亲密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与关怀才是乔布斯的真正遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy, and care is gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦表达本质，关怀是对物种的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risk to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的有意冒险；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实性拒绝虚假引擎声。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从以 Lean 为基础、扎根形式语言的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a path to scaling brilliance, not just a safety checkbox; verified generation beats informal methods on performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证是放大卓越能力的路径，而不只是安全合规的勾选项；经过验证的生成在性能和样本效率上都优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法是必需的，而自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Formal tools excel in structured domains like algebra but struggle in creative combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving.
carinahong.zh: 形式化工具在代数等结构化领域表现出色，却在创造性的组合数学中吃力；即便证明能力超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation across the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; verification should enable open collaboration and extend to all AI-generated code, not just niche safety domains.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；验证应促成开放协作，并覆盖所有 AI 生成的代码，而不局限于小众的安全关键领域。

mensch.en: Chinchilla corrected scaling laws: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出，Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型规模更关键。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality rival compute; value accrues at the application layer, not foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他强调效率与数据质量可与算力并重，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, decentralized and sovereign; it augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张拥抱 AI、推动去中心化与主权 AI，认为 AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, agents and enterprise customization; AGI as one system never exists.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正商品化，差异化转向垂直微调、智能体与企业定制，单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI infrastructure; sovereignty means enterprise engagement, open source and practical integration.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建 AI 基础设施，主权意味着企业深耕、开源与务实集成。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers, and models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏比是关键杠杆，模型因推理经济性被过度训练约 100 倍（超出 Chinchilla 最优）。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead, and low precision (FP4) yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也占主导；脉动阵列和暂存器内存减少开销，低精度（FP4）带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits, and optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但有质量限制，最优批大小取决于稀疏比而非模型规模。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure pushes smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年时，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链和强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；但前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈“锯齿状”，泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了泛化难题：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但需要海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式才能学会概念，不同于人类从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他肯定智能体式编码工具（如 Codex）通过并行工作将研究员生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但边缘锯齿状，需仔细监督。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具赋能自主智能体行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL is a green field, and narrow RL on math/coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习是绿野，数学/编码的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是 AGI 的核心路径；视频/图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; agents need a decade, with human oversight and fast verification.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年发展，需人类监督与快速验证。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is key.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据导致崩溃，剥离记忆的认知核心是关键。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 现在就善待模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福利塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; designers should trust expert judgment over steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案和直觉出发，而非固定流程；设计师应信任专家判断，而不是迷信步骤。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mockups to shipping and helping engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他断言“研究—发散—收敛”流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向快速交付并协助工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and early shipping build trust, though speed alone is not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月；快速交付与早期上线建立信任，但他强调速度本身不等于进步。

jennywen.en: He deepens a talent thesis: hire 'crack new grads' with blank slates, and favor block-shaped generalists over narrow T-shaped specialists.
jennywen.zh: 他深化人才主张：优先招“开窍的新毕业生”这类白纸型人才，并偏好“块状”通才而非狭窄的 T 型专家。

jennywen.en: Across all talks, craft, taste and human judgment remain the constant: humans still decide what matters as AI improves.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：工艺、品味与人类判断不变——即便 AI 进步，仍由人决定什么才重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调泛化才是智能的关键缺口：反对依赖密集奖励的强化学习，主张无目标的好奇心驱动探索，并把它落到真实机器人上。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training is required.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的样本效率与跨机器人泛化难题，到 2026 年明确把机器人定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠多样数据预训练加真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, ChatGPT-like, can power any embodiment; a cross-vertical data flywheel scales from structured to unstructured settings.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出通用机器人大脑可适配任意形态与任务，并以跨行业数据飞轮从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment, not just modeling, is the primary challenge: robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他把部署本身视为核心技术挑战：机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，必须经过严格真实环境测试。

pathak.en: Short-term optimism, long-term caution: progress keeps surprising experts, yet home robots' timeline remains highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的是对短期乐观、长期谨慎的态度：进展屡屡超出专家预期，但家用机器人的时间表仍高度不确定。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; interpretability is now achievable with modern tools, and hybrid rule-based systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，并反驳旧有看法：借助现代工具，端到端网络如今已可解释；而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data and world models let AI handle unseen scenarios and reason through blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他把泛化视为核心问题：靠多样化数据与世界模型，AI 才能应对未见场景，并在盲弯等情形下推理出安全行为。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves driving; data, compute and infrastructure matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破，且数据、算力与基础设施比算法创新更关键——这是他自认较晚才领悟的教训。

kendall.en: Language integration deepens: it improves representation, reasoning and personalization, enabling human interaction and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他对语言集成的论述深化：语言不仅改善表征，还提升推理与个性化，使驾驶模型能与人交互并具备内省能力。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors over retrofits; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third option, not the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的落地路线转向带内置传感器的大众消费车辆而非昂贵改装；安全上主张最小风险 maneuvers 与“第三种选择”，认为电车难题只是理论练习。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone, and governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链能保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日发布以学习，让真实世界反馈揭示涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司应先从简单产品做起，生存第一，并通过更高使命统一团队来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: AI is the future of phones: agentic software, generative UI, and applied AI that knows the user.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是手机的未来：智能体式软件、生成式 UI，以及了解用户的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; focus on user pain points, not hype. AI is an ingredient, not a selling point.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化反共识立场：多数 AI 是炒作，应聚焦用户痛点；AI 是配料，不是卖点。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature tech; make tech fun to inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他明确设计是成熟科技品类的主要差异化因素，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will evolve to intent-based, proactive agents; apps will disappear, but phones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他预测手机将演变为基于意图的主动智能体，应用会消失，但手机不会被眼镜取代。

edwinchen.en: Quality data and human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real measure of AI progress; AGI is a decade or more away.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是衡量 AI 进步的真实标准，而非基准测试或排行榜；从 80% 到 99.9% 的跨越极难，AGI（通用人工智能）可能还要十年以上。

edwinchen.en: Post-training is shifting toward reinforcement learning environments that simulate real-world tasks; next-token prediction alone may not reach AGI.
edwinchen.zh: 同年他提出：后训练正转向模拟真实任务的强化学习环境；仅靠下一个词预测，LLM 或许无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能），需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo reward clickbait; labs diverge by objective function, so no single model will rule all.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续批评 Elo 等不良基准会奖励标题党；前沿实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司最终都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment essential; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年谈医疗时，他认为模型会幻觉与虚构，人类判断比以往更关键；安全应优先于准确，而最大的风险或许是遗漏——未推荐重要行动。

edwinchen.en: AI can be the best teacher, yet using it to avoid struggle undermines learning; retrieval grounding and judgment distinguish truth.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他补充：AI 可以是最好的老师，但用它逃避思考会削弱学习；检索增强生成让回答有据可依，而辨别真伪仍靠人的判断。

nando.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化成序列的通用智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video, not just teleoperation, can train agents cheaply; the goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年主张让智能体像人一样从视频而非遥操作数据中学习，到 2026 年仍强调简化问题、拥抱失败，主线是低成本学习与创造新知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大的开放难题，并直言尚无解决方案——这是相较 2023 年更明确的转向。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy issues and local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年他强调非洲并非落后，反而能跨越遗留问题，本地语言模型可革新教育；这是对 2023 年多样性包容主张的具体深化。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, enabling models to learn new capabilities, not just elicit pre-trained knowledge.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习在预训练之外开辟了新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，使模型能学习新能力，而不仅是激发预训练知识。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck, not just capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度上的成功率衡量）才是真正瓶颈，而不仅是能力；编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and pre-training plus RL may reach AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞；Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），预训练加强化学习可能无需新突破即可达到 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more now; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具当前更重要；算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更好的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：小语言模型借助高质量合成数据可以变得强大；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and supplies infinite training data beyond the internet.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭后提供无限训练数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他提出大语言模型像操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；强化学习只负责底层控制，高层规划交给模型。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant end-to-end models scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端模型比学术界常见的复杂模块化方案更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models for synthetic data become the priority.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，于是仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据成为规模扩张（Scaling）的关键。

jimfan.en: He now bets robot foundation models will hit a GPT-3 moment in about five years, with intelligent robots outnumbering iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他给出更具体的时间表：机器人基础模型约五年内迎来 GPT-3 时刻，到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；同时强调 system one 底层控制仍是具身最难的部分。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, empower designers with ownership; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代，给设计师所有权；在高速成长的创业公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon: early investment differentiates and recruits; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是战略武器：早期投入带来差异化与招聘优势；人们加入的是品牌，而非公司。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon founders must articulate; hire diverse archetypes, avoid rigid crits, adapt process to the problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是创始人必须讲清的战略武器；招聘多元原型，避免僵化评审，让流程随问题而变。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需通过快速、零散的实验与技术债一同迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为事实来源；90 年代图层面板工具已是遗产。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment and robustness research is the highest-leverage path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，做实证性的对齐与鲁棒性研究是最高杠杆的路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed, with evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能的输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究，并指出评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded as the superalignment team dissolved and compute promises were broken; post-training alone can't align AGI, so external oversight is needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 的安全文化退化：超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐，需要第三方测试与外部监管。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律能通过算力和数据预测 AI 进步，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他指出智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他始终认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作往往更有效。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化观点：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, though self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配，而当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；不过自博弈与模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should generate or augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics demands 99.9% reliability for real value; one neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 仓储机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值；单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though what happens inside remains alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 靠下一个词预测训练，而这是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力和数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部究竟发生了什么仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk-averse big tech often slow progress.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的应用往往连创造者都预见不到；产品经理和惧怕品牌风险的大厂常常拖慢进展。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理侧算力扩展和长得多的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning boost reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 推理侧算力与强化学习提升推理能力，但单靠它们到不了 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力很关键，而 AGI 被低估了。
